neighbours.label: first-person diary or blog narration anchored in the writer's own present ('this week', 'right now', 'tonight'), as against impersonal statements on the same topics
fire: I have been thinking about my grandmother a lot this week, since her birthday is close.
We are packing boxes right now because the movers come on Monday.
I got a text this morning from my old roommate about the reunion.
My garden is a mess at the moment, but the tulips are finally coming up.
I'm writing this tonight from a hotel room in Denver.
Things have been hectic lately, so the next post will follow on Friday.
I am reading a wonderful novel these days and cannot put it down.
We had a surprise visit yesterday from our neighbors across the street.
quiet: Grandparents often play an important role in family celebrations.
Moving companies charge more for weekend jobs than for weekday ones.
Reunions are usually organized by a committee of former classmates.
Tulips grow best in well-drained soil with full sun.
Denver is the capital and largest city of Colorado.
Posts on the site are published according to a fixed schedule.
The novel tells the story of a family across three generations.
Neighbors in the area share tools and help with repairs.
